# Extraction of Jest Test Evidence for JavaScript/TypeScript Analyzers

This module implements a mechanism to extract concrete evidence from Jest tests (including those using 'test', 'it', and their .only/.skip variants) for JavaScript and TypeScript files. It records call evidence to imported module functions and HTTP request evidence with literal paths (from common test clients like supertest), specifically within actual test bodies. This supports deeper analysis and mapping of test coverage to code and endpoints.
